- Split the input string into sentences by delimiters '.', '!', '?' while preserving order; this can be done by iterating characters and collecting segments, or using regex to split on these delimiters.
- For each resulting sentence, strip leading/trailing whitespace, then check if it starts with "I" as a standalone word (i.e., sentence starts with 'I' followed by a space, end, or punctuation).
- Count and return the number of sentences satisfying the "I"-start condition; ignore empty segments produced by consecutive delimiters or trailing punctuation.
